verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing docs explicitly reference agile sprint templates, and community threads confirm sprint/backlog features are in active use (e.g., backlog triage, closed-sprint tracking), but the evidence pack lacks first-party detail on core sprint-planning mechanics (story points, burndown/velocity charts, sprint reports) and includes friction reports about locating closed-sprint tickets and general UI sluggishness. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of sprint planning features (burndown charts, velocity, capacity planning), independent hands-on validation specifically of sprint workflows.
